## Crypto Sniper Bot v1.2.0 Changelog

- Added API setup documentation (API_SETUP.md) for improved integration guidance.
- Introduced an official changelog file (CHANGELOG.md).
- Added an API testing script (test-api.js) to assist with endpoint verification and troubleshooting.
- Updated package.json and skill.json to reflect new features and support files.

Crypto Sniper Bot 1.1.0

- Improved trading engine and monitoring for pump.fun and four.meme tokens.
- Updated quality filtering and strategy evaluation logic.
- Documentation (README.md, SKILL.md) refreshed for accuracy and clarity.
- Enhanced configuration and notifications management.
- Dependency and package metadata updates.

Initial release of Crypto Sniper Bot with automated token sniping for Solana meme platforms.

- 24/7 automated monitoring of pump.fun and four.meme for new token launches
- Intelligent quality filtering using liquidity, holder count, token age, and market cap
- Automated buy/sell execution with configurable take-profit and stop-loss strategies
- Multi-channel notifications (Telegram, Discord, Email) for trades and bot events
- Real-time position tracking and complete trading history
- Integration-ready architecture with placeholder APIs and strong security measures
